name: Morning Mail

checkpoints.task: Deliver the west slip: type wren 04
Deliver the north slip: type umi tex
Deliver the east slip: type bea, vn

medal_rule: clean baseline then personal target, never gates story
desk_decoration: mail tray (mail_tray) for the player's desk
map_design_note: Start at the mailroom counter (20,14), through the open turnstile (opened by level 01), west along the south band, up to the west desk, along the north band to the north desk, then down the east band to the east desk and back to the mailroom. A simple loop around the garden with no hidden door; the cut-through shortens it after level 06 but is not needed. Checkpoints show on the world map after a first attempt.
baseline_note: The first clean run records the run's duration as a baseline and grants the First Delivery patch; later runs may show an adjustable personal target about 5% below the baseline. Accuracy gates the medal, speed never gates story.

terminal_scenes.task_summary: Type the label on the west desk's slip and deliver it.

feedback.other: The observed text is shown above the slip. Correct it right here and continue; nothing is lost.

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.text: Mira, courier. Learn the loop first: three slips, three desks. No clock this time; I only write down how long your first clean run takes, as your baseline.

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.text: Take the slips from the tray whenever you are ready.

dialogue.speaker: slip_card
dialogue.text: To write the number on the west slip, you need to press 0, then 4.

hint.action: To write the number on the west slip, you need to press 0, then 4.
hint.gesture: tap 0, tap 4. Plain taps stay digits on base.

dialogue.speaker: slip_card
dialogue.text: To write the u in the north slip, you need to press U.

hint.action: To write the u in the north slip, you need to press U.
hint.gesture: tap U. It only pages up while nav is held.

dialogue.speaker: slip_card
dialogue.text: To separate the east slip's two names, you need to press comma.

hint.action: To separate the east slip's two names, you need to press comma.
hint.gesture: tap comma. It only deletes forward while nav is held.

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.text: That slip says something else. Try the letters again; nothing is lost.

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.text: Clean run. That is your baseline, and I'll sew on the patch. A quicker loop is there if you want it; it never gates anything.
dialogue.cue: Mira: each patch, earned on a route's first clean baseline (pleased)
